sources.title: Long-Tailed Recognition on Binary Networks by Calibrating A Pre-trained Model
sources.snippet: Deploying deep models in real-world scenarios entails a number of challenges, including computational efficiency and real-world (e.g., long-tailed) data distributions. We address the combined challenge of learning long-tailed distributions using highly resource-efficient binary neural networks as backbones.
